items.title: Tumble posts its card: the Check, then the movement past enemies
items.do: On Kaela's turn, use Tumble (1 AP: Advance half her Speed). In the chat card, click Appeal Check or Instinct Check, then the card's Move button, and drag her through Goblin Sneak's square to the far side. Use it again (2 AP: Evade 2) between Orc Warrior and Goblin Sneak corner to corner. Try to end inside the Goblin's square.
items.expect: Each use posts Tumble's card to the chat (it no longer starts the movement by itself), with two Check buttons (Appeal Check, Instinct Check; set the DC and the Banes in the roll dialog by hand) and a Move button. The movement passes the enemies; she can't end in an enemy's square. After the Tumble, a normal Advance is blocked by the enemies again.

items.title: Aid's Check: an Appeal and an Instinct button
items.do: Make Sylwen Daunted, then on Kaela's turn use Aid on Sylwen and look at the card in the chat.
items.expect: The card's line reads "an Appeal Check or Instinct Check" with a button on each (was a button only on Instinct); each rolls that Attribute.
